audience: teams who collect responses, orders and signatures with Paperform and Papersign

useCases.title: Read the latest submissions of a form
useCases.text: The AI lists a form's fields and its newest submissions with answers, payment charge and date. It sums up what respondents wrote.

useCases.title: Find people who started a form but did not finish
useCases.text: The AI lists partial submissions and keeps those where submitted_at is empty, the abandoned ones, with the answers given so far and the last field answered.

useCases.title: Check product stock and sales on a shop form
useCases.text: The AI lists the products of a form with price, quantity in stock and sold count. You see what is selling and what is nearly out.

useCases.title: Check, add, enable or disable coupon codes
useCases.text: The AI lists a form's coupons, creates a new code with an amount or percentage discount and expiry, or enables or disables an existing one.

useCases.title: Check Papersign documents and get a signed PDF
useCases.text: The AI lists e-signature documents by status, shows the signers' progress, and gets a one-week download link for a fully signed PDF.
